mechanism_narrative: The two-week rise in WORKPLACES from -35.7 to -19.7 signals reopening commuting, which spills over into retail footfall and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -35.7 at t-2w to -19.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES continuing to rise above -20.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS weekly mean exceeds +20, outdoor activity substitutes for indoor retail, driving RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS exceeds +20 in a week but RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks is higher than its prior two-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL (>8) combined with near-zero GROCERY_PHARM indicates home confinement with essential-only trips, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL mean 9.8 and GROCERY_PHARM mean -0.3 over four weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays above 8 and GROCERY_PHARM stays within -2 to +2, yet RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Under a tightening transit-capacity regime where TRANSIT remains below -30, reduced station footfall depresses retail-and-recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -30.1 at t-0w and -34.4 at t-1w
failure_condition: TRANSIT stays below -30 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days rises above its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal spring increase in PARKS draws discretionary trips outdoors and away from retail, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS weekly mean rose to 36.3 at t-2w before falling to -7.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS rises week-on-week during spring but RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks is higher than its prior two-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES above -25 combined with TRANSIT above -32 signals broad reopening that lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES > -25 and TRANSIT > -32 are both observed, but RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks is lower than its prior two-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM turns positive (>0), precautionary stockpiling behavior causes consumers to avoid retail venues, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was +3.4 at t-2w and +0.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM is positive for a week but RETAIL_REC over the next week is higher than its prior week mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime where WORKPLACES recovers above -22 while RESIDENTIAL falls below 9, retail footfall rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES > -22 and RESIDENTIAL < 9 hold for two consecutive weeks, yet RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean.
